description: Jest Roblox specs for Luau game code and shared pesde packages, run in Studio through a connected Studio MCP and in CI through Open Cloud Luau Execution. Load it before planning or writing a spec, working test-first, adding a regression test for a bug fix, adding test coverage to existing systems, setting up Jest in a place or in CI, acting on a failing spec run in Studio or CI, or pruning a suite that has grown large.

results.query: Players can claim the daily reward twice if they rejoin quickly. Write a regression test for it first, then fix it.
Add Jest tests for ShopService's purchase method. A purchase the player can't afford should change nothing.
Set up Jest Roblox in this place so we can start writing specs.
Our GitHub Actions job runs the Jest suite through Open Cloud Luau Execution, but the job stays green even when specs fail. Why?
The InventoryService spec passes when I run it in Studio but fails in CI on Roblox's servers. What usually causes that?
Let's build the crafting system test-first, red then green, starting with recipe lookup.
Our Specs folder has grown to about 600 tests and nobody trusts it. Help me cut the redundant ones without losing coverage.
How do I fake DataStoreService in a Jest Roblox spec for my PlayerData module?
My spec run reports "FoodCatalog.spec failed to load: attempt to call a nil value (global 'describe')". What's wrong?
The pricing rule has five tiers with a discount at each threshold. How should I table-drive the specs for it with it.each?
Write unit tests for this TypeScript date utility using Jest and ts-jest.
Start a playtest and check that the coin counter goes up when my character touches a coin.
Set up TestEZ for this Roblox project so we can write .spec files for it.
Write a GitHub Actions workflow that runs selene and StyLua on every pull request.
Profile why the server's frame time spikes when 50 blocks are placed at once.
Add a UI Labs story for the Hotbar component so I can preview it in Studio.
Rename the PlacementRules module to BlockRules and update every require that points at it.
Write a pytest suite for our Python matchmaking service.
Validate the PlaceBlock remote's arguments on the server so exploiters can't send NaN positions.
luau-lsp says "Type 'nil' could not be converted into 'number'" on line 12 of BlockInventory.luau. What does that mean?
